title: Contingency Placement Agreements — Schedule of Term, Notice, Runoff and Signature Periods
content:
This schedule forms part of the terms of the Contingency Placement Agreements and states, for every tier, the length of the terms, the notice periods, the runoff period, the early-termination fee and the signature window.

## Terms

| Tier | Initial term (months) | Each automatic renewal term (months) |
|---|---|---|
| Starter Contingency Agreement | 12 | 12 |
| Standard Contingency Agreement | 12 | 12 |
| Preferred Contingency Agreement | 12 | 12 |
| Select Volume Contingency Agreement | 24 | 12 |
| Enterprise Contingency Agreement | 24 | 24 |
| Strategic Partner Contingency Agreement | 36 | 24 |

## Notice, runoff and early-termination fee

- **Non-renewal notice** — the calendar days before the term end by which notice of non-renewal must be given.
- **Termination notice** — the calendar days of notice for termination before the term ends.
- **Runoff** — the calendar days after the termination takes effect during which Ridgeline keeps working accounts already placed.
- **Early-termination fee** — the fee when the client terminates before the end of the initial term, in USD.

| Tier | Non-renewal notice (calendar days) | Termination notice (calendar days) | Runoff (calendar days) | Early-termination fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Contingency Agreement | 30 | 30 | 90 | 0.00 |
| Standard Contingency Agreement | 30 | 45 | 90 | 500.00 |
| Preferred Contingency Agreement | 60 | 60 | 120 | 1500.00 |
| Select Volume Contingency Agreement | 60 | 90 | 120 | 5000.00 |
| Enterprise Contingency Agreement | 90 | 90 | 180 | 15000.00 |
| Strategic Partner Contingency Agreement | 90 | 120 | 180 | 25000.00 |

## Signature window

The signature window is the calendar days after the agreement is issued within which the client must sign.

| Tier | Signature window (calendar days) |
|---|---|
| Starter Contingency Agreement | 30 |
| Standard Contingency Agreement | 30 |
| Preferred Contingency Agreement | 30 |
| Select Volume Contingency Agreement | 45 |
| Enterprise Contingency Agreement | 60 |
| Strategic Partner Contingency Agreement | 60 |

**Hypothetical reading.** A Select Volume Contingency Agreement runs an initial term of 24 months and then renews for 12 months at a time; its termination notice period is 90 calendar days and its early-termination fee is 5000.00 USD. A Starter Contingency Agreement carries an early-termination fee of 0.00 USD.
